notes: Keyed by '<codename>|<slot>'. The codename is the decoder's agent folder name; the agent display name comes from bot/replay/normalize.py AGENT_BY_CODENAME and is deliberately NOT duplicated here.

The in-game key is derived from 'slot' at draw time (utility_track.KEY_BY_SLOT); it is never derived from the folder letter in the class path (_Q_ / _4_), which is falsified on 4 of 5 lettered Haven classes (plan section 1).

'tokens' are matched case-sensitively as substrings of the full class path, longest token first; the class-path prefix (Projectile_/Zone_/GameObject_/Patch_/Ability_) and variant suffixes (_Explosion, _ThroughWall, _SmokeZone, _SecondWire) are not part of the identity.

'verified' lists every '<map>-<patch>' in which the class was observed, comma separated ('haven-13.06' for the Haven replay, 'pearl-13.08' for the Pearl replay); 'unverified' means no replay has shown it yet. Agents outside those two replays stay unverified (plan section 1 gaps, D3).

'source' is carried per value: 'GF' = the community wiki marks the number as read from game files, 'PN <patch>' = stated in Riot patch notes, 'EST' = community estimate, 'observed' = measured in this replay.
'effectClass' names the actor class that carries the ability's area/lifetime (the value the tracker pairs where the geometry allows and that the counts script uses for the AC-1.8 lifetime control).
Rows under 'auxiliary' are pulse/warning sub-objects of an ability that is already tracked; the tracker drops them so the map shows one item per throw.

P8-B2b re-slotted the two Hunter (Sova) utility rows: the drone classes that live in S0/Ability_E/Drone are Owl Drone, which the roster puts on C, so they moved from 'Hunter|Ultimate' to 'Hunter|Grenade'; 'Hunter|Ultimate' now names Hunter's Fury and carries the tree's only X class (S0/Ability_X/Ability_Hunter_X_LaserMulti). Neither row has a replay, so both are 'verified: unverified'.

Gumshoe|Ability1.name: Cyber Cage
Gumshoe|Ability1.effectClassNote: effectClass is the AREA actor (the AC-1.8 lifetime control and the item's effect block read it). The canister GameObject_Gumshoe_Q_CageTrap is listed as an alternative because it is what a throw physically lands on: the tracker pairs a throw with the canister for `land` and then attaches the activated Zone as the area when one follows the canister (same owner, <=300 units, any delay up to round end). Measured on the Haven 13.06 raw (the live store and the P7-1B re-decode agree): 16 cage throws, 16 GameObject_Gumshoe_Q_CageTrap and 14 Zone_Gumshoe_Q_Cage actors, and every Zone spawns at the exact ms its trap closes. The tracker attaches the right Zone on 16/16 throws: the 14 activated cages carry it (7,244-7,251 ms), and 2 cages were never activated (u14420/trap 14444, u37758/trap 37782: no Zone actor anywhere in the raw) and get `effect: null` (P7-1F2; counts corrected in P7-1F3).
Gumshoe|Ability1.durationNote: 0.75 s form + 6.0 s full + 0.5 s fade; the Zone actor lives 7.244-7.251 s (observed). The Gameobject_Gumshoe_Q_CageTrap canister lives 7-50 ms, so the Zone, not the canister, is the area (see effectClass).
Gumshoe|Ability1.source: community wiki, game-files column (GF): 3.72 m, 7.25 s; stop-surface angle 44.765 deg means it deflects off walls (observed: 3 of 16 throws bounce)

states.reason: Reyna Devour heal pool: a caster-side state actor, not thrown or placed utility (15 High + 1 AutoActivate on Pearl 13.08).

auxiliary.name: Recon Bolt
auxiliary.reason: the reveal pulse, not a thrown or placed object: it spawns 60 times per match at the stuck bolt (1.867-1.875 s each), while GameObject_Hunter_Q_SonarBolt is the bolt itself and is paired with the throw. Emitting both would put 97 Recon Bolt markers on one match's map instead of 37.

auxiliary.name: Paranoia
auxiliary.reason: the local preview line of Paranoia (1.493-1.500 s), spawned where the throw happens, not a thrown or placed object; the missile itself is the tracked item. It carries no Owner/Instigator in the export, so emitting it would also drag the ownership rate down (12 items per match, all unowned).

auxiliary.name: Blaze
auxiliary.reason: the wall's controller object (0.69-10.70 s lifetime, no Owner/Instigator in the export); the wall polyline itself is the Blaze projectile. Observed 10.69-10.70 s lifetime is reported in reports/p7-1a-utility.md so the P7-2A fade can use it.

notInCatalog.reason: Seen in a replay but deliberately left unclassified rather than guessed: the class name alone does not prove the ability or the slot (plan section 1: the folder letter is not the key). They are still tracked as kind 'unknown' and listed by the counts script. Caster-side state actors are not left here: the ones a replay has shown are named under 'states' and classified as kind 'state'.
classes: Gun_Deadeye_Q_Pistol (Chamber Headhunter: a gun state actor)
Pawn_BountyHunter_4_WolfHound + Ability_BountyHunter_4_WolfHoundBendable (Fade Prowler: a steered creature pawn, no thrown object)
